description: Pump is a tempo-training workout app. Connect it to ChatGPT to ask about your training history, analyze your progress, and build or edit the workout templates you train from. Changes show up in the Pump app on its next sync. ChatGPT sees only the account you sign in with, and deleting a workout always takes your confirmation.

defaultPrompt: Build me a 45-minute push day with a 3-1-1 tempo on the presses and add it to Pump.
How has my bench press progressed? Estimate my one-rep max for each session.

publication.release_notes: Fixes the 1.0.0 review. Category is now Healthcare. Every operation is its own tool (20 tools: search_workouts, get_workout, save_workout, add_exercise_media, delete_workout and so on), so none switches by a "type" parameter, and each sets all four hints explicitly for what it alone does. Read tools (search_*, list_*, get_*, export_history) are read-only, non-destructive, idempotent and closed-world: they read only the signed-in user's own Pump account. Write tools are not read-only and not idempotent. Destructive: save_workout (saving under an id replaces the workout's exercise list), update_exercise and update_settings (overwrite saved values), save_reminder (overwrites a reminder when given its id), add_exercise_media (replace overwrites media) and delete_workout / delete_reminder. Non-destructive: create_folder and update_notifications. Only add_exercise_media is open-world: it downloads a photo or video from a public web address. delete_workout always takes a preview with a one-time token, then the user's confirmation. Demo account: review@pumpfitness.app, password tempo-lift. On Pump's connect page choose Sign in with email, enter the email, then the password, then Allow.
